steps.title: Collect and wash embryos
steps.instruction: Collect 100-200 staged embryos in a 1.5 ml eppendorf tube and wash with PBT twice.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at <= 500 g for 1 minute or allow embryos to precipitate naturally.

steps.title: Homogenize embryos in Trizol
steps.instruction: Remove all liquid and add 50 µL of Trizol. Homogenize embryos using a plastic pestle.

substeps.instruction: Add an additional 50-150 µL of Trizol to wash the pestle, ensuring the total Trizol volume is 200 µL.

steps.title: Phase separation with chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 1/5 volume of chloroform (e.g., 40 µL for 200 µL of Trizol).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 00:15:00 at 12000 x g at 4 °C.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube and add 0.8-1 volume of isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 00:10:00 at room temperature (for high expected yield) or at -20 °C for 02:00:00 (for better precipitation).

steps.title: Wash RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and wash the pellet once with 200 µL of cold 70% EtOH.

substeps.instruction: Dislodge the pellet from the tube side without sucking it into the pipette tip.
Centrifuge for 00:10:00 at 12000 x g at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dry and recover RNA
steps.instruction: Optionally dry the pellet at 55 °C for 00:01:00.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 00:05:00 at 10000 x g at 4 °C.
Resuspend the pellet in 10-20 µL of RNAse-free water.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Measure the RNA concentration using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Perform DNAse treatment
steps.instruction: Use 1 µg of RNA (total volume should not exceed 6.4 µL).

substeps.instruction: Add 0.8 µL of DNAse buffer and 0.8 µL of DNAse I from Sigma DNAse I Kit (alternatively, 1 µL of each may be used).
If the total volume is less than 8 µL, add RNAse-free water to reach 8 µL.
Mix by pipetting and leave for 00:20:00 at room temperature.
Add 1 µL of Stop solution, mix by pipetting, and incubate at 65 °C for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a 200 μl PCR tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 μl of RT buffer and 1 μl of RT enzyme from High-Capacity RNA-to-cDNA Kit.
Mix by pipeting and place in a PCR machine.
Run the program: 37 °C for 01:00:00, then 95 °C for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Finalize cDNA
steps.instruction: Add RNAse-free water to reach a final volume of 200 μl.
